reviews.review:
Gameplay wise 
-some stages have different hazards to spice up the gameplay
-some stages have a sudden spike of enemies/mini bosses when you completed one part of the main objective so beware of that 
-shooting mechanics imo might be a little stiff at times (ie shooting and changing bullet types mid fight could use a little tweak , sometimes when you need to run/change bullet types and shoot simultaneously the character sometimes just can't keep up , especially when defending the terminals where the enemy spawns at both sides)

Art wise
Beautiful and immersive enough said

Solid Game overall for a normie like me if you like kingdom style-ish gameplay (there might be games similar out there but kingdom is the only one i played so yea :P )

Will update review in the future

Edited on 13/10/2025
Finished the game , was a fun ride , sure the story was short but compact enough to know the gist of it. 

Some final thoughts  
-Mechanics like shooting is still abit frustrating when surrounded by enemies on both ends but still able to power through if your're lucky enough  
-wish we got a ammo upgrade along with the bag capacity upgrade, kinda running very dry with every combat encounter when defending terminals. 
-Also had some weird issues on the cannon when you quick swapping cores too fast, it had a weird bug that only accepts red cores for some reason even when your bag have only blue and green cores
-also a nitpick ,that can we have transportation/teleportation in the later stages? it could make traveling from the left side to the right side much more smoother since the map it hella large in the late stages

Overall yea , is quite a solid game , would recommend :D

26/11/2025
Yea replayed the game again and i can say gunplay is much more smooth so kudos to the devs , the waves are much more easier to manage thanks to the timer display , havent met any weird bugs like some others mentioned but yea glad to see the game is improving :D
